name: Ring of Invisibility
description: A plain gold band that feels heavier the longer it is worn.
body:
## What it does

As an action you vanish, along with everything you wear and carry. You stay unseen until you take the ring off, attack, cast a spell, or choose to appear again as a bonus action.

spells.name: Invisibility
spells.note: on yourself only, at will, until you attack, cast a spell or take the ring off
